releaseNotes:
• Cleaner text. Numbers keep their case ("0.6 version", "2nd"), a pause no longer capitalizes the next word, and you can say "comma", "question mark", "full stop" or "scratch that" (Arabic: "علامة استفهام", "سطر جديد").
• Shortcuts stay shortcuts. ⌥← and other shortcuts with the key no longer start a dictation or lock hands-free mode. ⌃⌘V pastes your last dictation anywhere.
• No clipped words. The microphone opens without waiting for the speech engine and keeps listening a moment after you let go.
• Choose your microphone (or always use the Mac's own), and optionally pause music and video while you dictate.
…and more.
